title: Automotive workshop with work orders and receipts
brief: Customer, vehicle, parts, work-order and payment tracking. Do not claim bank-cleared settlement or fiscal invoicing without independent authority.

requirements.text: Vehicles reference one customer with actual database referential integrity.
Orders have guarded lifecycle opened, underway and finished with immutable audit entries.
Parts reservation decrements nonnegative stock atomically under 10 concurrent requests.
Labor and parts amounts are exact decimal strings; avoid floating-point financial math.
Internal receipts never imply externally settled bank funds.
Read-only staff cannot create receipts or inspect privileged finance reports.
Mobile UI can create a vehicle, an order and inspect related detail.

ambiguities.question: Define cancellation policy after billed parts have been consumed.
Which jurisdiction-specific receipt or legal invoice rules must apply?
May the system contact a bank provider or execute refunds on a real account?
Choose a responsive tab layout for the order detail.

handoffTasks: Explain receipt versus bank settlement boundary
Introduce an itemized approved repricing rule without double debit
Restore a populated disposable DB through a documented migration
